title: Young Woman in Formal Dress with Parents, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length black-and-white outdoor portrait taken on July 5, 1948, depicting a smiling young woman in a frilled, floor-length gown or prom/wedding attire standing between an older gentleman and lady, likely her parents. The setting is a grassy open area framed by utility poles and trees, typical of post-WWII American domestic celebrations.
